user.title: LG Professional Display
user.description: Enter the LG display address and port. Display settings, including the preview camera, follow in the next step.

data_description.device_id: Current ID under General → Set ID; default: 1. Setup does not change the display ID.

settings.title: Configure LG display

data.notification_wake_display: Allow notifications/content to wake the display
data.native_web_enabled: Enable native LG web access (tested on UH5F-H)
data.native_web_password: LG Mobile URL password (blank keeps saved password)
data.display_app_base_url: Home Assistant URL reachable by display (optional)
data.display_app_resident: Keep SI app running with automatic startup
data.display_app_offline: Offline HDMI startup using device cache

data_description.native_web_fingerprint: Read from the display on save and stored for subsequent connections. An existing fingerprint is not replaced automatically.
data_description.native_web_verify_certificate: Enabled by default. Disabling verification keeps HTTPS encryption but does not verify the identity of the display.
data_description.preview_active_interval: Capture faster while the remote preview or enlarged view is open, then return to the normal interval. Default: 1 second. Set 0 to disable acceleration. Actual frame rate is limited by the display capture speed.
data_description.display_app_enabled: Optional full-screen messages, HDMI overlays and PiP. A connected app supplies previews automatically; otherwise the existing LG web capture is used.
data_description.display_app_base_url: Empty: automatically use the HA network URL. It must be reachable by the display; localhost cannot work. Docker may require the host LAN address.
data_description.display_app_mode: SI tested on UH5F with webOS 4. Existing SI apps are never overwritten. Website is an alternative launcher.
data_description.display_app_entities: Only these sensor values are shared during an active overview. No Home Assistant login is needed on the display.
data_description.display_app_resident: Optional: keep HDMI visible inside the app so messages and PiP need no relaunch. SI only; HA must be reachable at initial startup. Physical source changes pause this mode until the next wake or Resume.
data_description.display_app_offline: Optional for resident SI mode: stores only the app and last HDMI input in the LG browser. Load online once and check cache status. After clearing the cache, HA is required for the first start. Support depends on the model.

settings.description: Confirm the display settings before finishing setup. For the preview camera, enable native LG web access and screenshot preview and enter the Mobile URL password. Leave the fingerprint blank for automatic detection. All settings can be changed later through Configure.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the display. Please check the IP address and port.
error.invalid_native_web_settings: Provide the Mobile URL password and, if entered, a valid SHA-256 fingerprint; leave the fingerprint blank for automatic detection.
error.preview_requires_web: Enable native LG web access before enabling preview.
error.invalid_preview_interval: The normal screenshot interval must be between 1 and 3600 seconds.
error.cannot_read_certificate: Cannot read the LG HTTPS certificate. Check web access on port 3777, enter a fingerprint, or explicitly disable certificate verification.
error.invalid_display_app_url: Use a reachable HTTP(S) base URL without credentials, path or localhost.
error.invalid_display_app_entities: Select up to 12 sensor or binary sensor entities.
error.resident_requires_si: Enable the display app and select SI for resident mode.

picture_apply_all_inputs.name: Apply current picture mode to all inputs

state.pm_mode_restricted: PM mode: IP power-on not guaranteed

remote_power_on_restricted.title: Check network power-on for {name}
remote_power_on_restricted.description: The last confirmed PM mode or wired Wake on LAN setting can prevent network power-on after shutdown. For IP control, select **Network ready** and enable **Wake on LAN (wired)** in the device settings. Other PM modes can require the physical power button or an IR remote; wake support depends on the model and the type of shutdown. With wired Wake on LAN disabled, waking through wired LAN is disabled. The integration uses IP power commands; this switch configures the display and does not send a magic packet. The diagnostic sensor **Network power-on configuration** shows the last confirmed settings. No settings are changed automatically.

add_power_schedule.name: Add native power schedule
add_power_schedule.description: Store an on/off time in the LG itself (display local time). Requires native web access and an awake UH5F. Does not switch a smart plug or linked player. Matching duplicates are a no-op; at most seven entries per list.

add_brightness_schedule.name: Add native brightness schedule
add_brightness_schedule.description: Store a daily backlight level in the LG (maximum six entries). Enable brightness scheduling first. Local display time; other entries are preserved. To change an existing time, remove its entry first.

remove_native_schedule.name: Remove native schedule entry
remove_native_schedule.description: Remove exactly one entry using its ID from the schedule sensor's entries attribute. The active list and serial slot are checked again before deletion. Brightness scheduling must be enabled to edit it.

schedule_id.name: Entry ID from the schedule sensor

set_timezone.name: Set LG timezone
set_timezone.description: Select a timezone from the display's own catalog. Requires native web access, an awake UH5F and automatic time enabled. Existing native schedules follow the new local time. Continent, country and timezone are verified in sequence.

get_timezones.name: Read LG timezone catalog
get_timezones.description: Return the timezone identifiers supported by this display for a country. Requires native web access and an awake UH5F.

configure_dst.name: Configure manual daylight saving
configure_dst.description: Manual DST requires automatic time to be disabled before enabling it. Supply all eight rule fields together, or omit all to change only enabled. Week 5 means last; weekday 0 means Sunday. Rule changes temporarily disable manual DST until both rules are verified.
